scope: Branches identified in the current conversation and retained v1-v5 corpus; not an exhaustive map of all relevant science.

branches.title: Causal frame
branches.hypothesis: Hold initial law, failure event and deadline fixed across actions.
branches.reactivation_trigger: An action comparison changes its initial equilibrium or target.
branches.minimal_test: Re-run two interventions from the same initial state and event.
branches.acceptance_gate: Only the admitted intervention changes.
branches.novelty_status: Established causal discipline, not a novelty claim.

branches.title: Action sufficiency
branches.hypothesis: Zero-error decision codes are action covers; joint compatibility can exceed pairwise structure.
branches.reactivation_trigger: A new task needs a minimal deterministic decision representation.
branches.minimal_test: Compare all safe-action covers with all encoder partitions.
branches.acceptance_gate: Matching constructive upper and exact lower certificates.

branches.title: Soft decision information
branches.hypothesis: Average mutual information and fixed-width zero-error storage are different requirements.
branches.reactivation_trigger: Nonzero mistakes or nonuniform context priors are admitted.
branches.minimal_test: Binary rate-distortion against exact decision values.
branches.acceptance_gate: Explicit risk-dependent bound with policy class fixed.

branches.title: Rare-event epistemic reliability
branches.hypothesis: Equal limiting mutual information can coexist with different catastrophic-error exponents.
branches.reactivation_trigger: Mean accuracy masks small-noise safety differences.
branches.minimal_test: Compare two near-perfect sensors with distinct error exponents.
branches.acceptance_gate: Correct combined failure-rate prediction with finite-noise caveats.

branches.title: Finite-time physical action
branches.hypothesis: A deadline-specific action cannot generally be replaced by the quasipotential.
branches.reactivation_trigger: A physical repair or sensing operation needs a calibrated failure law.
branches.minimal_test: OU oracle followed by fixed-frame bistable first passage.
branches.acceptance_gate: Controlled finite-time event rate, not only mean escape time.

branches.title: Critical scaling
branches.hypothesis: Critical geometry and deadline scaling interact nonuniformly.
branches.reactivation_trigger: Direct calculations deteriorate near saddle-node parameters.
branches.minimal_test: Rescaled quartic versus normal-form action.
branches.acceptance_gate: Uniformity scope and independent collapse verification.
branches.novelty_status: Classical exponents; new extension requires audit.

branches.title: Higher-dimensional variational fallback
branches.hypothesis: A multidimensional variational limit may replace scalar quadrature.
branches.reactivation_trigger: One-dimensional analytic reduction no longer applies.
branches.minimal_test: Two-dimensional controlled diffusion with a convergence witness.
branches.acceptance_gate: Justified limit or error certificate rather than visual agreement.

branches.title: Correlated substrate noise
branches.hypothesis: Local component error rates do not specify task failure.
branches.reactivation_trigger: An independence assumption creates implausible redundancy benefits.
branches.minimal_test: Two-error coupling polytope and common-mode fault adversary.
branches.acceptance_gate: Correct event for every admitted joint law.

branches.title: Fallible corrector upkeep
branches.hypothesis: The correction mechanism must itself have physical damage and upkeep.
branches.reactivation_trigger: A safe-code claim relies on an ideal corrector.
branches.minimal_test: Noisy correction plus fallible service and killed actuation.
branches.acceptance_gate: Explicit correction/service failure without claiming all interfaces are now fallible.

branches.title: Changing world / stale memory
branches.hypothesis: Repairing a representation can preserve obsolete knowledge.
branches.reactivation_trigger: Static-context storage is interpreted as continuing environmental knowledge.
branches.minimal_test: World flips versus paid fresh observation.
branches.acceptance_gate: A fixed-frame case where refresh beats copying.

branches.title: Hidden health and paid diagnostics
branches.hypothesis: The health flag and syndrome reader can themselves be wrong.
branches.reactivation_trigger: Readable health is the remaining trusted interface.
branches.minimal_test: Two hidden health states and one ambiguous observation; enumerate implementable finite controllers.
branches.acceptance_gate: Physically realizable sufficient state or certified observation gap.

branches.title: Approximate compositional certificate
branches.hypothesis: Uniform local approximation error transfers finite-horizon safety under the same realizable policy interface.
branches.reactivation_trigger: Exact symmetry breaks but row error can be bounded.
branches.minimal_test: Sensor calibration perturbation and policy-transfer regret.
branches.acceptance_gate: Nonvacuous finite-horizon bound and no infinite-support extrapolation.

branches.title: Exact readable quotient
branches.hypothesis: An aggregated state must be both predictive enough and physically readable.
branches.reactivation_trigger: Microstate enumeration becomes large or a statistic may hide W.
branches.minimal_test: Raw-bit oracle versus count convolution; asymmetric-cell falsifier.
branches.acceptance_gate: All block rows identical and policy lift implementable.

branches.title: Coupled implementation costs
branches.hypothesis: Whole prescriptions, not separately available commands, consume physical hardware.
branches.reactivation_trigger: A rowwise optimization invents a common contingent selector.
branches.minimal_test: Equal marginal actions, different feasible conditional policy maps and realization costs.
branches.acceptance_gate: Strict joint gap with a constructive costed policy.
branches.novelty_status: Known obstruction; stronger extension is open.

branches.title: Physical action/resource signaling
branches.hypothesis: Actions may store information in configuration, resources or environment.
branches.reactivation_trigger: A memory-erasure theorem ignores physical traces.
branches.minimal_test: Contingent repair-mode write and resource-state bypass.
branches.acceptance_gate: Every readable trace included before declaring information loss.

branches.title: Persistent versus fresh randomness
branches.hypothesis: Persistent policy coordination requires a physical state.
branches.reactivation_trigger: Convexifying policies improves a robust guarantee.
branches.minimal_test: Fresh coins versus fixed independent seed versus writable protected bit.
branches.acceptance_gate: No free persistent seed.

branches.title: Profiles and survivor mass
branches.hypothesis: Mean success and accuracy among survivors do not characterize robust viability.
branches.reactivation_trigger: An aggregate metric improves while some contexts collapse.
branches.minimal_test: Per-context Pareto profiles and unnormalized live mass.
branches.acceptance_gate: All failed mass and context guarantees retained.

branches.title: Support and spectral lifetime
branches.hypothesis: Rare failure and closed safe recurrence answer different questions.
branches.reactivation_trigger: Long expected life is interpreted as indefinite safety.
branches.minimal_test: Resolvent, support deletion and safe-set hitting probability.
branches.acceptance_gate: Separate reachability, probability-one safety and finite lifetime.

branches.title: Switching and coordination
branches.hypothesis: Safe coordinated products can arise from individually transient modes.
branches.reactivation_trigger: A fixed-mode no-go is applied to a switching controller.
branches.minimal_test: Nilpotent A/B product with a physically declared selector/clock.
branches.acceptance_gate: Coordination mechanism included in the architecture.

branches.title: Financed reconfiguration
branches.hypothesis: A better architecture must be reached before failure.
branches.reactivation_trigger: The safer controller is granted at time zero.
branches.minimal_test: Reservoir, risky installation, delayed versus earliest switching.
branches.acceptance_gate: Prefix-causal attainable switching policy.

branches.title: Finite design versus indefinite policy
branches.hypothesis: Horizon and noise limits need not commute.
branches.reactivation_trigger: Leading finite-budget asymptotics are used to claim indefinite survival.
branches.minimal_test: Log-log summability and small-support perturbations.
branches.acceptance_gate: One implementable schedule rather than free horizon-by-horizon redesign.

branches.title: Active sensing / dual control
branches.hypothesis: An action can change both the world and future observability.
branches.reactivation_trigger: Passive refresh cannot explain strategic acquisition.
branches.minimal_test: A physical probe changes actuator state and signal quality.
branches.acceptance_gate: No clairvoyant choice; sensor cost charged.

branches.title: Dynamic compatibility topology
branches.hypothesis: Groups of contexts can be incompatible although every pair is compatible.
branches.reactivation_trigger: A changing observation partition merges three or more contexts.
branches.minimal_test: Three-world overlapping safe-action sets with a dynamic memory collapse.
branches.acceptance_gate: A consequence beyond static set-cover reformulation.

branches.title: Replicator / evolutionary memory
branches.hypothesis: Selected composition is knowledge only if causally useful for future regulation.
branches.reactivation_trigger: Mechanisms are allowed to reproduce or reweight.
branches.minimal_test: Perturb composition while matching environment; compare future control.
branches.acceptance_gate: Causal utility beyond historical correlation.

branches.title: Semantic information and purpose
branches.hypothesis: Viability-relative semantics must not hide an arbitrary external objective.
branches.reactivation_trigger: Ontological conclusions exceed the operational contract.
branches.minimal_test: Ablate correlations and compare constitutive boundaries and viability definitions.
branches.acceptance_gate: Boundary-sensitive claims and strongest antecedent comparison.
branches.novelty_status: Open conceptual program with strong predecessors.

branches.title: Autonomy / external replay
branches.hypothesis: External trajectory equivalence cannot by itself identify self-maintenance.
branches.reactivation_trigger: An apparently intelligent trajectory is called autonomous.
branches.minimal_test: Matched external controller followed by interventions on sensing, memory and own repair.
branches.acceptance_gate: Architecture-relative identifiable distinction, not consciousness claim.
branches.novelty_status: Open scientific target, no general theorem.

branches.title: Physical calibration / thermodynamics
branches.hypothesis: Action, effort, bits and joules require separate definitions.
branches.reactivation_trigger: A normalized reliability law receives a physical interpretation.
branches.minimal_test: One fixed-frame noisy writing operation with work/energy accounting.
branches.acceptance_gate: Units, dependence, deadlines and prefactors controlled.
branches.novelty_status: Calibration not established by toy laws.

branches.title: Formal scalable synthesis
branches.hypothesis: Proof certificates can replace brute-force search beyond small examples.
branches.reactivation_trigger: Exact finite-controller enumeration becomes impractical.
branches.minimal_test: Encode a proved witness as SAT/MILP and compare the independent oracle.
branches.acceptance_gate: Independent certificate without dropping information constraints.
branches.novelty_status: Established tools; application not a novelty claim.

branches.title: Nonrectangular uncertainty
branches.hypothesis: A shared unknown hardware parameter cannot vary independently in every row.
branches.reactivation_trigger: Robust local composition is excessively conservative.
branches.minimal_test: Fixed hidden fault type versus an adversary changing it each epoch.
branches.acceptance_gate: Quantified relaxation gap with correct policy class.

branches.title: Nonfatal errors and redundancy
branches.hypothesis: Changing error consequences can invalidate a fatal-error resource law.
branches.reactivation_trigger: n log n or a positive-hazard no-go is stated universally.
branches.minimal_test: Tolerated mistakes, majority correction and recoverable degraded states.
branches.acceptance_gate: Decoder upkeep counted and changed event explicit.

branches.title: Unifying objectives as competitors
branches.hypothesis: Empowerment, path entropy and free-energy descriptions are comparison baselines, not assumed universal principles.
branches.reactivation_trigger: A scalar is proposed to replace distinct causal capabilities.
branches.minimal_test: Equal entropy/different control; equal influence/different upkeep; matched outputs/different causal organization.
branches.acceptance_gate: Separating example or equivalence under explicit assumptions.

branches.title: Oscillators and continuous agency models
branches.hypothesis: A continuous system should test a finite structural prediction rather than replace it with a visualization.
branches.reactivation_trigger: A verified finite result requires a physical realization.
branches.minimal_test: Coupled oscillators with explicit memory, repair and a fixed failure event.
branches.acceptance_gate: A certificate predicts the continuous experiment.
branches.novelty_status: Exploratory realization, not proof of agency.

rejected_simplifications.reason: Only valid as a separate parameter scan, not a fixed-frame causal contrast.

rejected_simplifications.claim: Pairwise compatibility determines joint action sufficiency
rejected_simplifications.reason: Three-way intersections can be empty although all pairs overlap.
Repair can erase it and environmental drift can make it obsolete.

rejected_simplifications.claim: Every fixed repair erases, so all feedback erases
rejected_simplifications.reason: Input-dependent repair selection can carry a bit through actions.
Conditioning away failed mass creates a fictitious guarantee.

rejected_simplifications.claim: All policy mixtures are free randomization
rejected_simplifications.reason: Persistent coordination needs a physically persistent variable.

rejected_simplifications.claim: Uniform resource allocation is always optimal
rejected_simplifications.reason: Complementarity can create a convex scarcity regime.

rejected_simplifications.claim: Finite-horizon n log n cost settles indefinite survival
rejected_simplifications.reason: Lower-order terms and causal resource availability still matter.

rejected_simplifications.claim: Marginal component errors determine task failure
rejected_simplifications.reason: Dependence and the logical event alter cancellation and common-mode failure.

rejected_simplifications.claim: Transient isolated modes imply all coordination fails
rejected_simplifications.reason: A coordinated product may contain a safe recurrent cycle.

rejected_simplifications.claim: Install the better architecture at the earliest feasible instant
rejected_simplifications.reason: Survival paid during funding can favor later installation.

rejected_simplifications.claim: A bounded-fault code proves safety under arbitrary thermal noise
rejected_simplifications.reason: Tiny new uncorrectable edges change infinite-horizon support.

rejected_simplifications.claim: Count-only aggregation survives heterogeneous cell noise
rejected_simplifications.reason: Current exact counterexample gives row-TV difference 513619/2000000.

rejected_simplifications.claim: Small local approximation error proves infinite safety
rejected_simplifications.reason: The finite-horizon coupling bound saturates and cannot certify recurrence.

gate_rules: At most two active branches; record evidence before changing status.
Reclassify a rediscovered theorem as an instrument, never as original.
After two scoped models with no new implication, freeze feature expansion and audit assumptions and prior art.
A nonzero aggregation residual triggers observable refinement or an explicit approximation bound.
A vacuous bound triggers a shorter certified horizon or tighter contracts, not a safety claim.
Keep initial law, event, horizon, information, implementation and resource contracts fixed across comparisons.
Every resumed branch names a minimal falsifier and retains contradicted results in this ledger.
